messages:
Maya S.: quick sync — noticed a schema drift between eval-runner v0.9.8 and storage API. some traces are landing with metadata moved around and our indexers are treating them as 'unknown' :grimacing:
Jun Park: ugh, saw a spike in 422s yesterday. upload logs show `missing required field: trace_version` for ~700 traces. stack: eval-runner -> trace-proxy -> s3-archiver
Ravi Patel: do we have an example payload?
Jun Park: pasted sanitized example:
```
{
  "sample_id": "abc123",
  "labels": ["summarization"],
  "metadata": {"prompt_len": 128},
  // old runner put labels at top level, new puts under sample_meta
}
```
Li Chen: thanks. so this is a schema evolution issue, not corruption. new runner added nested sample_meta and a `trace_version: \"v2\"` expectation but didn't set the header for backwards compat.
Maya S.: right — two problems: (1) storage indexer expects either v1 flat or v2 nested and currently treats unknown as error, (2) retention/eviction logic reads certain top-level keys that moved so we mis-ttl some traces.
Nora Gomez: proposal (short):
1) Add mandatory `trace_version` top-level string for all runners (v1/v2).
2) Storage API should accept both, but emit a warning metric and index a normalized canonicalized manifest.
3) Implement a short-lived compatibility shim in the indexer to normalize v1->canonical and v2->canonical for 30d.
4) CI: add a unit/integration test in eval-harness CI that uploads synthetic v1 and v2 traces and asserts index + retention keys are present.
5) Docs: clearly document schema evolution and the deprecation window (30d -> review).
Jun Park: +1. for (3) can we also emit a paged backfill job for traces that failed to index in last 7d? we saw ~1200 failures across tenants.
Ravi Patel: agree on backfill. we should also avoid storing both normalized and raw payloads forever — propose: keep raw payload for 7 days for debugging, normalized index forever (subject to retention).
Li Chen: technical notes: gzip vs brotli: some runners started using brotli at 1.2.0, indexer didn't advertise support -> 413/unsupported content-type. we should standardize allowed encodings in the runner config and CI.
Maya S.: Next steps I can own:
- PR to add `trace_version` required field to runner spec and add header population (Maya)
- Indexer changes: accept both forms and add normalization (Li)
- CI test: integration job to be added to eval-harness pipeline (Nora)
- Backfill job: quick script + alert for manual review if >500 failures (Ravi)
Nora Gomez: regarding retention default — ops asked for 90d for enterprise tenants, 30d for self-serve. we need a per-tenant policy in metadata and the indexer should read `retention_policy` if present.
Ravi Patel: can we store retention_policy in the canonical manifest as `retention_policy: tenant_default|overridden_days:NN`? keep it stringy to avoid multiple writes.
Li Chen: implementation detail: canonical manifest fields we rely on for TTL are `created_ts`, `tenant_id`, `workload`, `trace_version`, `retention_days`. make sure unit tests cover missing retention_days fallback behavior.
eval-ci-bot: added test job `eval-harness/trace-schema-compat` to the matrix, queued.
Jun Park: for telemetry — emit a metric `trace.indexer.schema_mismatch{from=runner_version,to=indexer_version}` and an alert if rate > 5/min for 10m.
Maya S.: I'll draft the PR and the migration plan this afternoon. quick Q: do we want the compatibility shim to auto-convert v1->v2 shape or convert both to a new `canonical_v1`? thoughts?
Ravi Patel: canonical manifest makes sense. conversion rules are simpler if we pick a single canonical shape that indexer, UI, and retention read from. conversion examples should live in the repo under `docs/schema-migrations.md`
Nora Gomez: +1. timeline: 1 week to PR & tests, another week for rollout and 30d shim window. ops to confirm retention choices.
Li Chen: I'll add encoding check to indexer and a small acceptance test for brotli/gzip permutations.
Maya S.: thanks team. tagging followups: @Nora Gomez please add the CI job config change, @Ravi Patel can you prototype the backfill script? :thumbsup:
Ravi Patel: on it. will post a draft script in the thread when ready.
Jun Park: leaving logs and example failure ids here for s3 team: s3://redwood-eval/failures/2026-03-19/ (redacted) :eyes:
Maya S.: ok closing the loop — will open individual PRs and ping here when they land. :sparkles:
